Synthetic Musings is Ravi Kalia's technical blog: write-ups on machine learning,
statistics, linear algebra, and the tooling around them. Part lab notebook, part
reference.

Every post is a self-contained [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) document. A post that
runs code pins its own Python environment, and its outputs are frozen and committed
with the source, so the whole site can be rebuilt without re-running anything. The
source, the environment recipes, and the writing rules are on
[GitHub](https://github.com/project-delphi/ml-blog/).
